newsitem.title: INDIA: Private debt placement surges in India.
newsitem.headline: Private debt placement surges in India.

text.p: Private placement of debt in India surged to 181.04 billion rupees ($5.06 billion) in 1996/97 (April-March) from 99.6 billion rupees in the previous year, a leading database firm said on Monday.
Prime Database said 158 institutional and corporate organisations mobilised the debt through the private placement of 204 issues during the year.
The firm said 90 percent of the amount was mobilised by government organisations through 80 issues.
The company said national financial institutions accounted for 46 percent of the debt while public sector firms controlled a 29 percent share.
Faced with poor conditions in the primary capital market, as many as 110 private companies opted for private placement in 1996/97, compared to only 15 in the previous financial year, Prime said.
